responsibility: Render grounded creation whose paragraph source IDs were explicitly emitted and validated against the current input allow-list, with stable Detail anchors, NoSource fallback, local copy/export and a user-mediated system share handoff. Never infer sources by paragraph position or claim a saved Note.

inputs.templateType: Preset creation template: letter | report | poem | timeline (US-SYN-003 AC-1)
inputs.sourceMemories: Retrieved memory summaries with citation anchors (US-SYN-002/003 AC-2)
inputs.generatedContent: Structured CreativePipeline output with per-paragraph explicit source MemoryIDs validated against sourceMemories; unknown/missing IDs become NoSource. Fixture output is Preview/test-only.
inputs.promptDraft: Personalized System Prompt draft (US-SYN-005) — editable, confirm/reset

outputs.visibleContent: Template picker, generation progress, validated source anchors, NoSource, copy/export/share/Save to Notes handoff actions and honest error states. Successful share-sheet presentation writes creationSharePresented with structured sharePresented=true; Echo does not record activityType, target App, completion or content.
outputs.interactionTargets: creation-generate, creation-copy, creation-export, creation-save-to-notes, creation-retry, creation-edit-prompt, creation-confirm-prompt, creation-reset-prompt, creation-citation-anchor-*
outputs.accessibilityTree: Generated content with source citation semantics; system share handoff is announced without claiming a final save result; prompt editor is editable text with confirm/reset actions

systemContainer: NavigationStack (pushed from MemoryDetailView creation entry) + ScrollView + Form sheet (prompt editor) + confirmationDialog (export format) + item-driven system share handoff
